To Whom It May Concern;
This letter is an attempt to explainmy plansfor the liquor license we are purchasing/
transferring from KZ Corporation to Mason Properties, Inc.

Goofy's).I owned the property from 1983 to 1997 when I sold it to KZ Corporation.
Donna Keeney of KZ Corporation approached me to buy the property, including the
liquor license back a few weeks ago.We have completed the sale.
Enclosed, please find a drawing showing our intent for the property to be re-developed.
As youmay know, wehave just completed a $70o,000+remodeling on the adjoining
property at 2813-2825 E.Lincolnway. Our plan is to demolish the octagonal building,
previously known as Goofy's or Daisy Dukes and to replace the building with a 6,500 s.f.
commercial property to house three businesses.

package liquor storewith approximately2,100-2,200s.f.Wemay consider a small
whetherwe operate this liquor store/lounge orleaseit.

was a past president of the Cheyenne Liquor Dealer's Association andI assure you I
appreciate the responsibilities of owning a liquor license.
